body:
Claiming the §U item 3 build (provenance & audit symmetry + the meter's UI half, rows B + G, fixes F5).

Scope:
- Backend: a retry-attempt ledger on tool dispatch (per-attempt outcome + count riding the tool_call record); a typed injected-items record per turn (kind/source/label/EXACT rendered text captured inside the composer, emitted as a context_injected obs event per surface); the provider-death degraded signal persisted as a phase in build_agent_phases.
- Frontend: turn outcome truth — a turn whose reply carries the canonical error renders FAILED (header, plan pill stops reading as progress on a dead run); retry counts + last attempt error visible on tool steps; an inspectable "injected this turn" list in the context panel with an opaque fallback for unrecognized kinds.
- Live proof: a new wire-capture script asserting record==wire symmetry (the items' text appears verbatim in the captured prompt), the retry ledger on a live failing tool, and the degraded phase + error object on a synthesis death.

Why safe: additive records and frontend honesty; no prompt-text changes on existing paths, no provider/model special-casing; the four chat surfaces' injection behavior is untouched (item 2's guarantees ride as-is).
